title: thai-pdpa-guard policy
description: What to do with each kind of personal data the guard finds. Point your editor at this file to get completion and errors while writing pdpa-policy.json or .yaml. definePolicy() and parsePolicy() enforce the same rules at load, and test/policy-schema.test.ts keeps the two in agreement.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, so your editor can check the file as you type. Ignored by the guard and not part of the policy hash.

entitySet.description: The entity set this policy was written against, e.g. "0.1". Entities added in later releases are handled by onUnmapped until you add a rule for them. Required, so an upgrade can never change what happens to your data without you seeing it. D1.

onUnmapped.description: What happens to an entity the guard finds that this policy has no rule for. redact (default) keeps a new data type from leaking the day you upgrade. flag lets it through and reports it. ignore lets it through silently, and has to be written by hand. D1.

entities.description: One rule per entity type. Leave one out and onUnmapped applies to it.

TH_NATIONAL_ID.description: Thai national id / tax id, 13 digits with a mod-11 check digit.

PHONE.description: Thai mobile or landline number, national or +66 form.

BANK_ACCOUNT.description: Bank account number. Found only when the sentence says it is one — a bare run of digits is not claimed.

CREDIT_CARD.description: Payment card number with a valid Luhn digit.

LINE_USER_ID.description: LINE user id (U + 32 hex). Group and room ids are not covered.

allowlist.description: Values let through even though they are found — your own support address or call-centre number. Applies to every entity. A value let through is still reported, with allowlisted: true. D1.

exact.description: Exact values. Compared after formatting is removed, so "02-123-4567" also matches 021234567 and ๐๒๑๒๓๔๕๖๗.

pattern.description: Regular expressions that must match the WHOLE value, after formatting is removed (emails lower-cased, numbers digits only). Anchors are added for you. Tested against the found value only, never the whole message.

placeholderLanguage.description: Language of redact placeholders: [เบอร์โทร] or [phone]. Does not affect hash output, which always uses the English entity name.

action.description: redact → [เบอร์โทร] · mask → xxx-xxx-7777 · tokenise → [tok:…], resolvable by an allowed purpose · hash → [PHONE:…], stable and one-way, needs hmacKey · flag → left as is, reported · block → the whole message is stopped.

minConfidence.description: Findings below this are ignored. Lower it to act on weaker matches, such as a Luhn-valid number with an unknown card issuer (0.6).

keep.description: mask only. Leave the last four characters visible. Without it, mask hides everything except separators. D8.1.

ttlSec.description: tokenise only. Seconds a token can be resolved, counted from when it was first issued. D6.

allowedPurposes.description: tokenise only, and required for it. The purposes guard.resolve() accepts. A token no purpose may resolve is redact that reads worse — use redact instead. D6, D8.4.

display.description: tokenise only. What the customer sees when the model writes the token into a reply that goes out through the guard (boundary: outbound). mask → the value as typed, all but the last four hidden (xxx-xxx-7777). redact → the placeholder ([เบอร์โทร]). The full value is never shown. D10.1.
